purpose: Source-addressed, graph-inert intake of BVVC leadership, portfolio listing, selected public roles, School.House and fellowship descriptions, partial official vehicle records, transaction announcements, rejected joins, and open acquisition work.

selection.selection_universe: Every visible name on the acquired current BVVC leadership page, every visible label on the acquired current Portfolio Universe page, selected official profiles, exact-name SEC records found in the bounded pass, and transaction-specific counterpart announcements.
inclusion_rules: retain every visible leadership and portfolio label from the two declared current pages
retain source-specific role labels without inventing dates or authority
retain exact SEC filer identities without collapsing vehicles into the public brand
retain transaction rows only when a counterpart or official source names BVVC
exclusion_rules: no selection based on criticism, ideology, nationality, military unit, or anticipated scandal value
no private messages, screenshots, or owner-supplied profile exports as public evidence
no inference from portfolio listing to ownership, control, governance rights, or a particular fund vehicle
selection.symmetry_rule: Apply the same legal-entity, financing, role, governance-right, government-surface, and explicit-null searches to all 27 leadership labels and all 30 portfolio labels.

boundaries: A current portfolio listing is not a legal ownership or control record.
A fellowship or dense leadership roster does not establish direct contact or coordination.
An operations role does not establish investment, portfolio-company, moderation, or public-communications authority.
A Form D notice does not prove the complete vehicle universe, beneficial ownership, or transaction-specific use of proceeds.
Absence from the acquired current page or limited transaction set is not proof of no historical relationship.
